---
title: "GO enrichment of NuFANCI-enriched proteins"
output: html_notebook
---

GO Molecular Function and Biological Process enrichment (Enrichr 2023 libraries) of a protein list, using the enrichment functions of FragPipe-Analyst (`R/enrichment_functions.R`, https://github.com/MonashProteomics/FragPipe-Analyst).

**Input:** `protein_common.csv` (column `ProteinID`, UniProt accessions).
**Output:** `GOMF.pdf`, `GOBP.pdf`.
**Note:** taken from the 2025-10-19 analysis.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("~/FragPipe-Analyst/R/enrichment_functions.R")
# setwd("path/to/data")  # folder with the input tables (see header)
```
```{r}
proteinids <- read_csv("protein_common.csv")
```
```{r}
library(biomaRt)
library(UniProt.ws)
#mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl") # mouse
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl") # human

ensembl_gene_id <- getBM(c("ensembl_gene_id","uniprot_gn_id"), "uniprot_gn_id", proteinids$ProteinID, mart)

```

```{r}
GOMF <- enrichr_mod(ensembl_gene_id$ensembl_gene_id, "GO_Molecular_Function_2023" )
GOBP <- enrichr_mod(ensembl_gene_id$ensembl_gene_id, "GO_Biological_Process_2023" )
GOMF = GOMF$GO_Molecular_Function_2023
GOBP = GOBP$GO_Biological_Process_2023
```
```{r}
terms <- GOMF %>%
  dplyr::filter(Adjusted.P.value <= 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Adjusted.P.value) %>%
  dplyr::slice(seq_len(10))

ggplot(terms, aes(y = reorder(Term, Odds.Ratio), x=log2(Odds.Ratio), size=Overlap, color=Adjusted.P.value)) +
                 geom_point() +
                 scale_color_continuous(high = "#487db5", low="#d16e67", name = "P.value",
                                        guide=guide_colorbar(reverse=T,
                                                             label.theme = element_text(angle = 90),
                                                             label.vjust = 0.5)) +
                 labs(y = "Term", x = "log2 Odds ratio", size = "size") +
                 theme_bw() +
                 theme(legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 9), aspect.ratio=2/1)
ggsave("GOMF.pdf")
```
```{r}

  dplyr::filter(Adjusted.P.value <= 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Adjusted.P.value) %>%
```
